text.zh-CN: 太阳相对天球赤道的角位置，也对应太阳直射点的纬度。它随季节在南北回归线之间变化，影响各地昼长与太阳高度。
text.en: The Sun's angular position north or south of the celestial equator also gives the latitude of the subsolar point. Its seasonal change affects daylight duration and the Sun's height in the sky.

text.zh-CN: 太阳越过当地子午线的时刻，一般也是当天太阳高度最高的时刻。由于经度与均时差的影响，它不一定发生在钟表的12点。
text.en: The moment the Sun crosses the local meridian is usually its highest point of the day. Longitude and the equation of time mean it need not coincide with 12:00 on a clock.

text.zh-CN: 将太阳在黄道上的视位置每15度划分一段，得到二十四节气。它们依据太阳位置确定，因此对应的公历日期通常只在小范围内变化。
text.en: The 24 solar terms divide the Sun's apparent path along the ecliptic into 15-degree intervals. Because they follow the Sun's position, their Gregorian dates vary only slightly from year to year.

items.source: 香港天文台 · Hong Kong Observatory

title.zh-CN: 霜降：秋天的最后一个节气
title.en: Frost's Descent: the last solar term of autumn

text.zh-CN: 霜降是二十四节气中的第 18 个，也是秋季的最后一个节气。霜是贴近地面的白色冰晶；在黄河中下游，初霜一般出现在 10 月下旬到 11 月上旬。闽南和台湾有霜降吃鸭子的习俗。
text.en: Frost's Descent is the 18th of the 24 solar terms and the last one of autumn. Frost is a layer of white ice crystals near the ground; along the middle and lower Yellow River, the first frost usually comes in late October or early November. In southern Fujian and Taiwan, people traditionally eat duck on this day.

items.source: 中国日报双语新闻 China Daily
